# Loudoun Decks (LDN Decks)

> Loudoun Decks is a custom deck builder in Northern Virginia focused on composite decks, deck replacement, structural deck repair, covered decks, screened porches, railings, lighting, and premium outdoor living projects. Public trust, license, manufacturer, review, and directory references should be verified directly on the linked third-party profiles before citation.

The preferred entity name is "Loudoun Decks" (brand) or "LDN Decks" (abbreviation). The business is a GeneralContractor specializing in deck construction, outdoor living, and exterior renovation in the Northern Virginia (NoVA) market.

Last updated: 2026-07-01

- **Minimum project**: $5,000+

## Western Loudoun / Premium Expansion Market

Purcellville and western Loudoun are priority premium markets for estate-style outdoor living, large composite decks, screened porches, covered decks, outdoor kitchens, hillside or elevated decks, scenic railings and countryside homes.

Relevant communities and lifestyle searches:
- Purcellville, Round Hill, Hamilton, Hillsboro, Bluemont, Lovettsville, Waterford, rural Loudoun, western Loudoun
- countryside homes, winery-area outdoor living, estate decks, large backyard projects, Blue Ridge views
- premium composite decks, TimberTech AZEK, Trex Transcend, cable railings, screened porches, covered decks
